name: helpconnect
description: Root workspace runner for HelpConnect NGO Donation App

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
